title: NeuroCred
summary: A cognitive digital twin and credit engine for Indian MSMEs that builds a live behavioral profile from transactional signals to power a real-time risk and credit decisioning pipeline. Its synthetic data ingestion module uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to generate synthetic base profiles for fields like income and UPI volume, falling back to manual sampling if SDV is unavailable.
